title: notepad_manifest.v1
description: The manifest of one sealed notepad version (06_AgentZone/07_Agent_Notepad.md §2). The service writes it when an agent calls seal(), before the push; the commit carries its digest in a Notepad-Manifest trailer. Its digest is sha256 over its canonical JSON (compact, key-sorted, ASCII), the same rule as the compliance contracts. Each manifest names the one before it, so a missing or altered version breaks the chain. A manifest is never edited: a change is a new version.

agent.description: The agent type that owns the folder, for example builder or reviewer.

version.description: The sealed version: v<version>/ in the folder.

previous.description: The digest of version - 1's manifest; null only for version 1.

sealed_at.description: UTC with a literal Z, at most microseconds, hashed exactly as written. Set by the service's clock, never the agent's.

writer.description: The subject of the workload identity that sealed, taken from its token claims.

files.description: Every file in the version, sorted by path, each path once.

inputs.description: The read-only inputs this version answered, verified by digest when they were placed.

id.description: A platform ID used as one path segment: it starts with a letter or digit, so it can never be . or ..

path.description: Relative to the version folder: at most five segments, no .., no leading slash, and only .md, .json, or .jsonl files.
